section_header: INTRODUCTION — Vehicle Lift and Support Locations
title: VEHICLE LIFT AND SUPPORT LOCATIONS

content.description: Top view diagram of vehicle showing lift and support points. Shows vehicle outline from above with front arrow indicator, and crosshatched circles indicating jack and support positions at four corners and center locations. Drive train components visible in center of vehicle.
Side view diagrams showing proper jack placement at front and rear of vehicle. Two illustrations show floor jacks positioned at seam notches near wheel wells.
